DEN_Entrance_Trade
Arron is a halfling trader in The Hollow of the Emerald Grove in Act One.
“
Is there anything you need? Act fast if you do - the ritual will be complete before too long.
„
— Arron, offering to trade

Involvement

Arron is the first merchant the party can meet and trade with in Baldur's Gate 3. He sells some "bits and bobs" that he no longer needs.

Companion approval

When a party character interacts with Arron for the first time, he admits that shutting off the Grove is a drastic measure but hopes Silvanus will guard the refugees.

  • Seems like most are tieflings. They'll be fine. They have devilish powers.  +1  -1  -1

Alchemy supplies

Arron rolls on one of the following two tables. Each single 'roll' on these tables is 3.4 alchemy ingredients on average.

Herb Supply Table 1 1/2

Arron rolls once or twice on the following two tables. Each single 'roll' on these tables is 3.4 alchemy supplies on average, meaning Arron has 5.1 rare alchemy ingredients on average.

Item Quantity Chance
